title: Natural Hard-Negative Mining from Positives for Instruction-Following Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.36900v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Instruction-following information retrieval (IFIR) requires retrievers to rank documents by both a query and its instance-specific instructions, yet instruction-conditioned contrastive supervision remains scarce. Existing synthetic methods typically fix a positive passage and generate additional negatives, overlooking the hard-negative potential of the original positive. We propose Natural Hard-Negative Mining (NHNM), which promotes convertible negatives under query-compatible instructions and repurposes original positives as natural instruction hard negatives. Its automated Candidate Cleaning, Reversal Construction, and Geometry Filtering pipeline produces compact, high-contrast supervision aligned with the pretrained retrieval space. Applied to MSMARCO, NHNM yields NHNM-MARCO, an IFIR training set of nearly 7K instances. translated_title: 面向指令跟随检索的从正例中挖掘自然困难负例方法
translated_abstract: 指令跟随信息检索（IFIR）要求检索器同时根据查询及其特定实例的指令对文档进行排序，然而以指令为条件的对比监督数据仍然稀缺。现有的合成方法通常固定一个正例段落并生成额外的负例，忽视了原始正例本身蕴含的困难负例潜力。我们提出了自然困难负例挖掘（NHNM），该方法在查询兼容的指令下促进可转换负例的产生，并将原始正例重新用作自然的指令困难负例。其自动化的候选清洗、反转构造和几何过滤流水线生成了与预训练检索空间对齐的紧凑且高对比度的监督数据。应用于MSMARCO后，NHNM生成了NHNM-MARCO，一个包含近7K实例的IFIR训练集。在InstructIR和FollowIR基准测试中，在NHNM-MARCO上微调的568M至4B参数规模的模型取得了强大的指令跟随检索性能。
tldr: 提出自然困难负例挖掘（NHNM）方法，通过自动流水线将原始正例转化为自然的指令困难负例，构建了近7K实例的IFIR训练集NHNM-MARCO，显著提升了各规模指令跟随检索模型的性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes Natural Hard-Negative Mining (NHNM), an automated pipeline that repurposes original positives as natural instruction hard negatives to build NHNM-MARCO, a ~7K-instance IFIR training set that significantly improves instruction-following retrieval performance across model scales.
